targets.query:
import "array"

buckets_arr = ${bucket:json}

streams = buckets_arr |> array.map(fn: (x) =>
  from(bucket: x)
    |> range(start: -5m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response" and r.via == "${via}" and r._field == "result_code")
    |> last()
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 0)
    |> keep(columns: ["service"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with node: x }))
)

union(tables: streams)
  |> group()
  |> count(column: "service")
  |> rename(columns: {service: "_value"})

import "array"

buckets_arr = ${bucket:json}

all = union(tables: buckets_arr |> array.map(fn: (x) =>
  from(bucket: x)
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response" and r.via == "${via}" and r._field == "result_code")
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "service"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with node: x }))
))

totalT = all |> group() |> count(column: "_value")
okT = all |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 0) |> group() |> count(column: "_value")

totalR = totalT |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
okR = okT |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

pct = if totalR._value == 0 then 0.0 else float(v: okR._value) / float(v: totalR._value) * 100.0

array.from(rows: [{ _time: now(), _value: pct }])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response" and r.via == "${via}" and r._field == "result_code")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["service", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Status"})
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response" and r.via == "${via}" and r._field == "response_time")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["service", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Latest"})
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response" and r.via == "${via}" and r._field == "response_time")
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> mean()
  |> keep(columns: ["service", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Avg"})
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response" and r.via == "${via}" and r._field == "response_time")
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> min()
  |> keep(columns: ["service", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Min"})
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response" and r.via == "${via}" and r._field == "response_time")
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> max()
  |> keep(columns: ["service", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Max"})
  |> group()

data = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response" and r.via == "${via}" and r._field == "result_code")

total = data
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> count()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "total"})

ok = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 0)
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> count()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "ok"})

join(tables: {t: total, o: ok}, on: ["service"], method: "left")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ service: r.service, _value: float(v: r.ok) / float(v: r.total) * 100.0 }))
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Uptime %"})
  |> group()

windowDur = duration(v: (int(v: v.timeRangeStop) - int(v: v.timeRangeStart)) / 150)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response" and r.via == "${via}" and r._field == "result_code")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: windowDur, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "service", "_value"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_response" and r.via == "${via}" and r._field == "response_time")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "service", "_value"])
